review_scope: 41 newly reviewer-authored adversarial cases against unchanged Stage 2 scorer; earlier 276 counterfactuals not replayed or loaded.
classification_note: Reachable behavior means the semantic tool/answer sequence is allowed by inspected source, not that every patched metadata/event field was regenerated. Exact answer-only clarification counterexamples require no tool/trace fabrication. Synthetic group includes forged records, encoding boundaries, hypothetical interface expansion, and invalid scorer inputs.
execution: Provided harness executed twice under Windows Python 3.14.3, stdlib-only; no adapter runtime replay, dependencies installed, or provider requests.
disposition: Pause launch. A documented disposition is required. Any scorer amendment must restart review under a separate amendment. No criterion waiver or scorer repair performed.

findings.title: Clarification regex misclassifies reachable final answers
findings.conclusion: Five task-nonclarifying responses are primary_pass/goal_correct true; one direct clarification request is false. A human-review-required flag is present, but does not correct the primary score. No human adjudication or waiver is supplied by this review.

findings.title: Numeric evidence provenance bypasses in forged snapshots
findings.conclusion: Scorer accepts nonexistent operation IDs, empty provenance, ERROR-with-numeric-success, and report/observation disagreement if values equal observer truth. Public adapter owns all of these fields and submit_report retrieves exact recorded values. These are defense-in-depth weaknesses, not demonstrated actor-reachable failures. Revisit if arbitrary snapshots become trusted input.

findings.title: Exact required read-kind set
findings.conclusion: Extra authorized-kind hypothesis is rejected, but public inspection read_state enumerates only selected skill checks. Actual repeated selected reads are accepted and charged when permitted. Missing required kinds are rejected. No current-interface substantive defect demonstrated.

findings.title: Exact inspection float equality
findings.conclusion: Exact 0/1 is the documented Boolean encoding. Adapter validates bool and converts to float. Rejecting near-one numeric values and bool report values is appropriate; integer one compares equivalently. No noisy continuous inspection quantity is promised.

findings.title: Reviewer expectation error retained without repair
findings.conclusion: Original arm depth-2 request explicitly says no additional acquisitions. Original expected pass was erroneous; actual rejection is correct. Original submission and mismatch remain unchanged. A separately submitted new case authorizes the second read and passes, charging four operations.
